name: Don Chente Mexican & Seafood
tagline: Birria, seafood and Mexican plates at two Bryan locations.
about: Don Chente opened in early 2021 and added a second Bryan location later that year, and it made its name with birria tacos.
Destination Bryan suggests pairing the birria with a michelada, and points to seafood like fish enchiladas and barbecue shrimp.
